La proximité sémantique n’est pas une pr: Semantic similarity does not prove clinical correctness. Missing points do not necessarily indicate a clinical error.
« Non reconnu » ne signifie pas nécessai: Not recognised does not necessarily mean medically wrong. Unattempted sections receive zero; this is an indicative, non-certifying result.
Scores stockés uniquement dans ce naviga: Scores are stored in this browser only (localStorage), without an account or server. Conversations and identifiable patient data are not stored. Scores are experimental and are not certification results.
Grille créée pour la démonstration, non: Teaching rubric created for demonstration; not validated for medical certification. Historical treatments described in source PDFs are not presented as current recommendations.
